svg.text: End-to-end pipeline from contributor PR → Grafana Cloud provisioning. Fully automated, audited, idempotent.
Automated validation: YAML/JSON lint, LBAC checks
THREE CORE PROPERTIES OF THIS PIPELINE
Same workflow for both BU stacks
Mechanically identical to Pattern 005 — only the destination shape changes.
Zero click-ops. Every Grafana Cloud resource is declared as code. Reverting a configuration is a git revert.
Akeyless extension on roadmap • Scope: Lending & Payment BUs only • Alloy distributed per workload (see Diagram 01)
